fightSong.title: Amen
fightSong.lyrics: Sing it loud from the pew to the field / Bible Belt boys never yield / Preach it, teach it, let it ring / Nashville's got that championship swing!

stadium.name: The Tabernacle
stadium.tradition: The Choir — a 100-person gospel choir sings the national anthem and then a fight song. If they go a cappella, we're winning.

fanCulture.description: They bring hymnals (with plays drawn in). After touchdowns they do the 'hallelujah hands.' It's country, it's church, it's football.
fanCulture.tailgate: Hot chicken, sweet tea, and acoustic guitars.

rivalries.name: The Southern Sermon
rivalries.narrative: They have peaches, we have preaching.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: First down! Can I get an amen?

cityFlavor: Music City, hot chicken, and Sunday morning energy on Sunday afternoon.
